Run with `--cycle 240` to alternate healthy phases and these faults, or pin one with `--scenario NAME`. The alerts listed are the ones each fault is designed to trigger; thresholds are calibrated to the demo traffic.

### `slow-llm`: Provider latency degradation

**What changes:** LLM latency x3.2 (TTFT and decode)

**What you see**

- TTFT p95 and end-to-end p95 rise
- Stage latency: `llm` dominates, retrieval unchanged
- Quality and cost per request unchanged

**Alerts:** `RagTTFTHigh`, `RagLatencyHigh` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#latency-regression)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Latency row -> Stage latency p95
- Click a TTFT exemplar -> `chat large-model` span is slow
- TraceQL: `{ resource.service.name = "support-rag" && duration > 6s }`

### `bad-index`: Bad reindex / stale index

**What changes:** Top-1 similarity -0.30, empty retrieval 12%, groundedness -0.22, index age 60 h

**What you see**

- Top-1 similarity p50 drops; empty / low-score retrieval ratio rises
- Groundedness (judge) falls; thumbs-down rises
- Index freshness panel crosses 48 h
- Latency and cost look normal: only quality tells you

**Alerts:** `RagRetrievalDegraded`, `RagGroundednessLow`, `RagIndexStale` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#retrieval-degradation)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Quality row (top-1, empty ratio, freshness)
- TraceQL: `{ span.eval.flagged = true }` (kept at 100% by the tail sampler)
- Logs: `|= "weak retrieval" | index_version="…"`

### `cost-spike`: Context bloat

**What changes:** Context tokens x4.5

**What you see**

- Cost per request and spend per hour jump (about 3x)
- Context tokens p50/p95 and input tokens rise
- Quality roughly unchanged

**Alerts:** `RagCostPerRequestSpike` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#cost-spike)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Cost row -> Context tokens, tokens in vs out
- Cost by tenant / feature to find the owner
- Compare `rag.context.tokens` on a spike trace vs a normal one

### `provider-errors`: 429 / 5xx storm

**What changes:** Provider error rate 50% per call (3 attempts, fallback to small model on the 2nd)

**What you see**

- Error ratio rises; retries and fallbacks per request rise
- Requests served by `small-model` (cost down, quality down)
- Latency up from retry back-off

**Alerts:** `RagErrorBudgetFastBurn`, `RagRetryStorm` · [runbook](https://github.com/akashtalole/ai-observability/blob/main/docs/operations/runbooks.md#provider-errors-and-rate-limits)

**Investigate**

- Dashboard: Error ratio, retries & fallbacks
- Logs: `|= "llm call failed"` (error_type, attempt)
- TraceQL: `{ name =~ "chat .*" && status = error }`
